Based on what you've told me, yes. Under our policy a parcel counts as lost after 10 business days with no tracking update. I can't see the tracking history, so I'm relying on your 12 business days. NW1004 (Standard, to Coimbra) still shows "In transit".

What to do:
- Open a lost-parcel claim. Claims must be opened within 30 days of the promised delivery date. Yours was 2026-11-15, so the deadline is 2026-12-15.
- Compensation: you would receive the declared value, which is 30 EUR. That is well under the 500 EUR limit.

I don't have the policy details on the exact channel or form for opening a claim, so I can't say where to submit it.
